Unlike Ocean.io, Dealmayker shows you who's ready to buy, why they're in-market, and exactly how to approach them. ### What's the main difference between Ocean.io and Dealmayker? Ocean.io costs $79-129+/month for lookalike matching and TAM discovery. If you need to find 100 high-fit companies showing buying intent this month, Dealmayker is purpose-built for that and delivers results faster at lower cost. Ocean.io's lookalike matching is only as good as your existing customer base - if you've been selling to the wrong accounts, it finds more wrong accounts. ### Does Dealmayker provide contact data like Ocean.io? Yes, Dealmayker provides company profiles and contact information for discovered leads, but our differentiation is the sales intelligence layer - ICP fit scores, buying signals, personalization angles, and conversation starters. Ocean.io gives you contacts at similar companies; Dealmayker gives you context on why each contact is worth reaching out to and exactly what to say when you do.

results.title: Intent Data Tells You Who’s Interested. Network Signals Tell You What to Do Next. | Commsor Blog
results.content:
And intent data is great, it shows you who might be ready to buy. Instead of spraying and praying with your messages, at least you are targeting folks that might be thinking about you. The problem is that it doesn't tell you what to do next.

That’s where network signals come in. They’re the only time of signal that leads to an actionable next step.

## The Rise (and Plateau) of Intent Data

Before we had any data, marketing’s main goal was to blast out messages about products and services to as many people as possible. The problem is that when people are receiving unsolicited messages, they are far less likely to give a positive response.

When buyers moved to online shopping, sellers realized they were leaving breadcrumbs behind. [...] These breadcrumbs became what we know as intent data. It showed where someone was interacting with your brand, like clicking on your website. It solved a visibility problem that gave signals that someone might be in-market for your product.

Intent data worked wonders in the early 2010s when few teams used it. But today, buyers are hit with hundreds of “I saw you’re hiring” messages. A recent LinkedIn study found that 72% of buyers now ignore outreach that references surface-level intent signals because it feels impersonal. [...] Tips & Tricks

results.content:
### Wrong Accounts Get Your Time

You spend hours on cold leads while hot ones slip away. Without real-time signals, you're working whoever's next in the queue instead of whoever's ready to buy.

The solution

## Sales Automation That Tells You Who's Hot and Why

Swan monitors signals across channels and surfaces your hottest leads in real-time. You get instant context on why they're hot and everything you need to act. Swan handles the mundane work so you focus on selling.

### Know Who's Hot

Red polygonal flame icon with geometric facets on a transparent background.

"Tell me which accounts are showing buying intent today." Swan monitors website visits, content downloads, funding events, hiring signals, and engagement activity. You always know who to focus on and why. [...] ### Signal Buried in Noise

Website visits, intent signals, funding news, LinkedIn engagement. Buying signals are everywhere, but you can't see them. You're guessing who to call instead of knowing who's ready to buy.

### No Way to Prioritize

Every lead looks the same in your CRM. You can't tell who visited pricing yesterday from who filled a form six months ago. Prioritization is guesswork, not data.

### Research Kills Velocity

By the time you research an account, find the right contacts, and understand what they care about, the buying window has closed. They've already talked to your competitor.

### Wrong Accounts Get Your Time
